svg.title: absentia process: archive, claim, N×M scoring, attestation
svg.desc: ingest parses seven documents into seven pages and 21 chunks with a sha256 manifest. variants turns the claim into four deterministic phrasings. scan scores 21 chunks times 4 variants, 84 comparisons, using FTS5 trigram with a LIKE fallback and local sentence vectors, combining with max. attest writes an INCONCLUSIVE verdict with 0.25 below tau 0.62 and core_sha256 181e3e900d0c6011, render writes a one-page ledger, and verify rebuilds in a temporary directory and returns AGREES.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: PROCESS / FROM AN ARCHIVE TO ONE ATTESTATION

text.font-family: 'Space Grotesk', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif
